verdict.rationale: Support response-time guarantees and escalation paths are a fair question for a cloud hosting platform, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents support tiers, guaranteed response times, or escalation paths for any plan. A community remark that Render has 'better support' is general sentiment, not a documented support commitment.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I know the guaranteed support response times and escalation paths for my plan tier
